Non-food contact surface or equipment ma.en: Non-food contact surface or equipment made of unacceptable material, not kept clean, or not properly sealed, raised, spaced or movable to allow accessibility for cleaning on all sides, above and underneath the unit.

A food facility shall at all times be co.en: A food facility shall at all times be constructed, equipped, and maintained, and operated as to prevent the entrance and harborage of animals, birds, and vermin, including, but not limited to rodents and insects
A food facility shall at all times be co.zh: 食品设施在任何时候的建造、配备、维护和运营均须能防止动物、鸟类和虫鼠害(包括但不限于啮齿动物和昆虫)进入和藏匿。

A room, area, or cabinet separated from.en: A room, area, or cabinet separated from any food preparation or storage area, or warewashing area shall be provided for the storage of cleaning equipment and supplies
A room, area, or cabinet separated from.zh: 须提供与任何食品制备区、储存区或器皿清洗区隔开的房间、区域或柜子,用于存放清洁设备和清洁用品。

Adequate and suitable space shall be pro.en: Adequate and suitable space shall be provided for the storage of food, on approved shelving with a minimum of 6 inch clearance from the floor
Adequate and suitable space shall be pro.zh: 须提供充足且适宜的食品储存空间,食品应存放于合规货架上,距地面至少6英寸。

All clean and soiled linen shall be prop.en: All clean and soiled linen shall be properly stored; non-food items shall be stored and displayed separate from food and food-contact surfaces. Utensils and equipment shall be handled and stored so as to be protected from contamination
All clean and soiled linen shall be prop.zh: 所有洁净及脏污布草须妥善存放;非食品物品的存放和陈列须与食品及食品接触面分开。器具和设备的取用和存放须能防止受到污染。

All new and used equipment and utensils.en: All new and used equipment and utensils shall be certified or classified for sanitation by an American National Standards Institute (ANSI) accredited certification program, e.g. NSF, ETL Sanitation, UL Sanitation, CSA Sanitation
All new and used equipment and utensils.zh: 所有新设备、二手设备及器具均须经美国国家标准协会(ANSI)认可的认证项目进行卫生认证或分级,例如NSF、ETL Sanitation、UL Sanitation、CSA Sanitation。

All permanent food facilities that wash,.en: All permanent food facilities that wash, rinse, soak, thaw, or similarly prepare foods shall be provided with a food preparation sink with a single integral drainboard. The food preparation sink shall have a minimum dimension of 18"x18"x12" (LxWxD) with an integral drainboard at least 18"x18" (LxW)
All permanent food facilities that wash,.zh: 所有进行清洗、冲洗、浸泡、解冻或以类似方式处理食品的固定食品设施,均须配备带一体式沥水板的食品处理水池。食品处理水池最小尺寸为18"x18"x12"(长x宽x深),一体式沥水板至少为18"x18"(长x宽)。

Each permanent food facility shall be fu.en: Each permanent food facility shall be fully enclosed in a building consisting of permanent floors, walls, and an overhead structure
Each permanent food facility shall be fu.zh: 每个固定食品设施均须完全封闭于由永久性地面、墙体和顶部结构构成的建筑内。

Elevate all food at least 6 inches off o.en: Elevate all food at least 6 inches off of the floor to prevent contamination. Properly label bulk ingredient/food containers with common name
Elevate all food at least 6 inches off o.zh: 所有食品须离地至少6英寸存放,以防污染。散装原料/食品容器须正确标注常用名。

Eliminate sewage backflow into the facil.en: Eliminate sewage backflow into the facility. Clean and sanitize all areas contaminated with sewage with a bleach solution (1 cup bleach per 9 cups water). Hire a licensed plumbing contractor if necessary. All contaminated food items must be discarded. All items that cannot be properly sanitized must be discarded
Eliminate sewage backflow into the facil.zh: 消除污水回流进入设施的情况。用漂白水溶液(每9杯水加1杯漂白剂)清洁并消毒所有受污水污染的区域。必要时聘请持牌管道承包商。所有受污染的食品必须丢弃。所有无法妥善消毒的物品必须丢弃。

Eliminate the infestation/activity of co.en: Eliminate the infestation/activity of cockroaches/rodents/flies/vermin from the food facility by using only approved methods. Remove all evidence of the infestation and thoroughly clean and sanitize all affected surfaces. Construct, equip, maintain and operate the food facility so as to prevent the entrance and harborage of animals, birds and vermin including, but not limited to, rodents and insects
Eliminate the infestation/activity of co.zh: 仅使用合规方法消除食品设施内蟑螂/啮齿动物/苍蝇/虫鼠害的侵扰与活动。清除所有虫害痕迹,并彻底清洁、消毒所有受影响的表面。食品设施的建造、配备、维护和运营须能防止动物、鸟类和虫鼠害(包括但不限于啮齿动物和昆虫)进入和藏匿。

Ensure all equipment is approved, proper.en: Ensure all equipment is approved, properly installed, clean, and maintained in good repair. Ensure all appliances are NSF-approved, commercial grade, durable, and easily cleanable
Ensure all equipment is approved, proper.zh: 确保所有设备合规、安装正确、保持清洁且维修完好。确保所有电器设备均经NSF认证、为商用级、耐用且易于清洁。

Ensure all food is separated and protect.en: Ensure all food is separated and protected from potential cross contamination. Store produce and ready-to-eat foods completely separate or above raw foods including but not limited to raw eggs, fish, meat, ratites, game animals, and poultry. Provide adequate sneeze-guard protection, a container that has a tight fitting and securely attached lid, or dispense food from an approved mechanical dispenser
Ensure all food is separated and protect.zh: 确保所有食品分隔存放并受到保护,防止潜在交叉污染。果蔬及即食食品须与生食完全分开存放或置于生食上方,生食包括但不限于生鸡蛋、鱼、肉、平胸鸟类(鸵鸟等)、野味及禽肉。须提供足够的防喷嚏罩、带紧密贴合且牢固连接盖子的容器,或使用合规的机械分配器分发食品。

Floor drains shall be installed in floor.en: Floor drains shall be installed in floors that are water-flushed for cleaning and in areas where pressure spray methods for cleaning equipment are used
Floor drains shall be installed in floor.zh: 以水冲洗方式清洁的地面,以及使用高压喷淋方式清洁设备的区域,均须安装地漏。

Floor surfaces shall be coved at the jun.en: Floor surfaces shall be coved at the juncture of the floor and wall with a 3/8 inch minimum radius coving and shall extend up the wall at least 4 inches
Floor surfaces shall be coved at the jun.zh: 地面与墙体交接处须做圆弧踢脚,弧形半径至少3/8英寸,并沿墙面向上延伸至少4英寸。

Food, equipment, or utensils that are fo.en: Food, equipment, or utensils that are found to be unsanitary or in disrepair may be Voluntarily Condemned and Destroyed by the person in charge
Food, equipment, or utensils that are fo.zh: 经发现不卫生或损坏失修的食品、设备或器具,可由现场负责人自愿报废并销毁。

Hand sinks shall be sufficient in number.en: Hand sinks shall be sufficient in number and conveniently located so as to be accessible at all times
Hand sinks shall be sufficient in number.zh: 洗手池须数量充足且位置便利,确保随时可用。

IMMEDIATE HEALTH PERMIT SUSPENSION AND C.en: Immediate health permit suspension and closure: The permit to operate this food facility is temporarily suspended, and the facility is ordered immediately closed under Sections 114405 and 114409 of the California Health and Safety Code (Division 104, Part 7, Chapter 13, Article 3) and/or City and County of San Francisco Health Code §§ 440 (j) and 440.1. The facility must cease all food handling and remain closed until all conditions warranting the closure are corrected and the permit is reinstated by Environmental Health. The operator may request a hearing within 15 calendar days after service of this notice. The CLOSED placard was issued and posted on this date.
IMMEDIATE HEALTH PERMIT SUSPENSION AND C.zh: 立即暂停健康许可证并勒令停业:依据《加州健康与安全法典》第104编第7部第13章第3节第114405条及第114409条和/或《旧金山市县卫生法典》§§ 440 (j) 及 440.1,本食品设施的经营许可证即予暂停,并责令立即停业。设施须停止一切食品操作并保持关闭,直至所有导致停业的问题整改完毕且许可证经环境卫生部门恢复。经营者可在本通知送达后15个自然日内申请听证。已于当日签发并张贴“CLOSED”(停业)告示牌。

Immediately provide hot running potable.en: Immediately provide hot running potable water of at least 120°F or greater for the entire food preparation facility
Immediately provide hot running potable.zh: 立即为整个食品制备设施提供至少120°F的流动热饮用水。

Keep clean and free of litter or rubbish.en: Keep clean and free of litter or rubbish the premises of each food facility; non-food items shall be stored and displayed separate from food and food-contact surfaces; the facility shall be kept vermin proof; open-air barbecues shall be operated in an approved manner
Keep clean and free of litter or rubbish.zh: 各食品设施的场所须保持清洁,无杂物或垃圾;非食品物品的存放和陈列须与食品及食品接触面分开;设施须保持防虫鼠害;露天烧烤须按合规方式操作。

Keep potentially hazardous foods (PHF) c.en: Keep potentially hazardous foods (PHF) cold at 41°F or below or hot held at 135°F or above. Immediately discontinue storing PHF at room temperature
Keep potentially hazardous foods (PHF) c.zh: 潜在危害食品(PHF)须冷藏保温于41°F或以下,或热保温于135°F或以上。立即停止在室温下存放PHF。

Label all potentially hazardous foods fo.en: Label all potentially hazardous foods for use with Time as a Public Health Control implementation with the date and discard time. The discard time shall be 4 hours after food preparation has begun or after removing from proper temperature controls of 41°F or 135°F. Discard potentially hazardous foods, under Time as a Public Health Control, when 4 hours have elapsed. Obtain written approval for Time as Public Health Control from San Francisco Environmental Health
Label all potentially hazardous foods fo.zh: 所有采用以时间作为公共卫生控制(TPHC)的潜在危害食品(PHF)须标注日期和丢弃时间。丢弃时间为食品开始制备后,或脱离41°F或135°F的温度控制后4小时。采用TPHC的潜在危害食品满4小时须丢弃。须取得旧金山环境卫生部门对TPHC的书面批准。

Maintain nonfood contact surfaces clean..en: Maintain nonfood contact surfaces clean. Thoroughly clean and degrease the cooking equipment and shelves above cooking equipment
Maintain nonfood contact surfaces clean..zh: 保持非食品接触面清洁。彻底清洁烹饪设备及其上方搁架并去除油污。

Maintain onsite an accurate, easily read.en: Maintain onsite an accurate, easily readable metal probe thermometer suitable for measuring temperature of food shall be available. A display thermometer +/- 2F shall be provided for each hot and cold holding unit of potentially hazardous foods and high temperature warewashing machines
Maintain onsite an accurate, easily read.zh: 现场须备有准确、易读、适用于测量食品温度的金属探针温度计。每台潜在危害食品(PHF)热保温和冷藏保温设备以及高温器皿清洗机均须配备精度±2°F的显示温度计。

Make available the most recent routine i.en: Make available the most recent routine inspection report. Post the Health Permit to Operate and restaurant license certificate in a conspicuous area for public view
Make available the most recent routine i.zh: 备妥最近一次例行检查报告以供查阅。将健康经营许可证和餐厅执照证书张贴在醒目位置供公众查看。

Obtain a state approved food safety cert.en: Obtain a state approved food safety certification course within 60 days of operation or when a Food Safety Manager has left the facility. Maintain copies of food safety certificates (food safety manager and food handler cards) on site
Obtain a state approved food safety cert.zh: 须在开业60天内或食品安全经理离开设施时,完成州认可的食品安全认证课程。现场须保存食品安全证书副本(食品安全经理证书及食品从业人员卡)。

Properly wash, rinse and sanitize all fo.en: Properly wash, rinse and sanitize all food contact surfaces. Make a 100 ppm bleach sanitizing solution or a 200 ppm quaternary ammonia solution for the third compartment
Properly wash, rinse and sanitize all fo.zh: 正确清洗、冲洗并消毒所有食品接触面。第三格水槽须配制100 ppm漂白水消毒液或200 ppm季铵盐溶液。

Protect the potable water supply with a.en: Protect the potable water supply with a backflow protection device, as required by applicable plumbing codes. All plumbing, plumbing fixtures, and grease interceptors shall be installed in compliance with local plumbing ordinances, shall be maintained so as to prevent any contamination, and shall be kept clean, fully operative, and in good repair. Any hose used for conveying potable water shall be of approved materials, labeled, properly stored, and used for no other purpose
Protect the potable water supply with a.zh: 按适用管道规范要求,使用防回流装置保护饮用水供应。所有管道、管道器具及隔油池的安装须符合当地管道法规,维护须防止任何污染,并保持清洁、完全正常运行且维修完好。任何输送饮用水的软管须采用合规材质、贴有标识、妥善存放,且不得作其他用途。

Provide a designated area for refuse, re.en: Provide a designated area for refuse, recyclables, and compost separate from food, equipment, and utensils
Provide a designated area for refuse, re.zh: 须设置与食品、设备和器具分开的垃圾、可回收物及堆肥物专用区域。

Provide a floor plan showing the path-of.en: Provide a floor plan showing the path-of-travel to the refuse storage area
Provide a floor plan showing the path-of.zh: 提供标示前往垃圾存放区通行路径的平面图。

Provide an approved warewashing facility.en: Provide an approved warewashing facility. Obtain chlorine test strips to monitor chlorine sanitizer solutions and mechanical dishwasher. Obtain quaternary ammonia test strips to monitor quaternary ammonia sanitizer solutions
Provide an approved warewashing facility.zh: 提供合规的器皿清洗设施。配备氯测试试纸,用于监测含氯消毒液及机械洗碗机。配备季铵盐测试试纸,用于监测季铵盐消毒液。

Provide exhaust hoods to remove toxic ga.en: Provide exhaust hoods to remove toxic gases, heat, grease, vapors, and smoke and be approved by the local building department. Canopy-type hoods shall extend 6 inches beyond all cooking equipment. Toilet rooms shall be vented to the outside air by a screened openable window, an air shaft, or a light-switch activated exhaust fan, consistent with local building codes. Adequate lighting shall be provided in all areas to facilitate cleaning and inspection. Light fixtures in areas where open food is stored, served, prepared, and where utensils are washed shall be of shatterproof construction or protected with light shields
Provide exhaust hoods to remove toxic ga.zh: 须安装排烟罩以排除有毒气体、热量、油脂、蒸汽和烟雾,并经当地建筑部门批准。伞形排烟罩须超出所有烹饪设备边缘6英寸。卫生间须按当地建筑规范,通过带纱网的可开启窗户、通风井或与照明开关联动的排风扇向室外通风。所有区域须提供充足照明,便于清洁和检查。在存放、供应、制备敞开食品及清洗器具的区域,灯具须为防碎结构或加装灯罩防护。

Provide minimum 6 inches high side splas.en: Provide minimum 6 inches high side splashguard(s) with rounded corners
Provide minimum 6 inches high side splas.zh: 须安装高度至少6英寸、带圆角的侧挡水板。

Provide soap and single-use towels in di.en: Provide soap and single-use towels in dispensers, or a drying device at each handwash sink at all times. Maintain all handwash sinks unobstructed and accessible at all times
Provide soap and single-use towels in di.zh: 每个洗手池须始终配备皂液,以及装于分配器中的一次性擦手纸或干手装置。所有洗手池须始终保持无遮挡、可随时使用。

Provide walls / ceilings using materials.en: Provide walls / ceilings using materials that are durable, smooth, nonabsorbent, light-colored, and washable surfaces. All floor surfaces, other than the customer service areas, shall be approved, smooth, durable, and made of nonabsorbent material that is easily cleanable. Approved base coving shall be provided in all areas, except customer service areas and where food is stored in original unopened containers. Food facilities shall be fully enclosed. All food facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair
Provide walls / ceilings using materials.zh: 墙面/天花板须采用耐用、光滑、不吸水、浅色且可清洗的材料。除顾客服务区外,所有地面须为合规、光滑、耐用、不吸水且易于清洁的材料。除顾客服务区及以原装未开封容器存放食品的区域外,所有区域均须设置合规的墙基圆弧踢脚。食品设施须完全封闭。所有食品设施须保持清洁且维修完好。

Rapidly cool potentially hazardous foods.en: Rapidly cool potentially hazardous foods from 135°F to 70°F within 2 hours, then from 70°F to 41°F within 4 hours. Discontinue cooling PHF's at room temperature. Rapid cool by any of the following approved methods: 1) Ice water bath 2) Ice wand 3) Shallow stainless steel pans filled 2-3 inches and store in refrigerator 4) Separate into smaller or thinner portions and store in refrigerator 5) Blast chiller 6) Any combination of the above. Use the following approved methods provided on the rapid cooling guideline
Rapidly cool potentially hazardous foods.zh: 潜在危害食品(PHF)须在2小时内由135°F快速冷却至70°F,再于4小时内由70°F冷却至41°F。停止在室温下冷却PHF。可采用以下任一合规方法快速冷却:1) 冰水浴 2) 冰冷却棒 3) 使用浅口不锈钢盘,盛装深度2-3英寸后放入冰箱 4) 分成更小或更薄的份量后放入冰箱 5) 急速冷却柜 6) 以上方法任意组合。请按快速冷却指南所列的合规方法操作。

Sink compartments shall be large enough.en: Sink compartments shall be large enough to accommodate the immersion of the largest equipment and utensils
Sink compartments shall be large enough.zh: 水槽各格须足够大,能将最大的设备和器具完全浸入。

Store wiping cloths used to wipe service.en: Store wiping cloths used to wipe service counters, scales, or other surfaces that may come into contact with food in clean water with sanitizer or use only once; separate sanitizing containers shall be provided for wiping cloths used with raw animal foods
Store wiping cloths used to wipe service.zh: 用于擦拭服务台、秤或其他可能接触食品表面的抹布,须存放于含消毒剂的清水中,或仅使用一次;用于生动物性食品的抹布须配备单独的消毒容器。

Submit specification sheets of proposed.en: Submit specification sheets of proposed equipment to DPH for review and approval, prior to purchase and installation
Submit specification sheets of proposed.zh: 拟用设备在采购和安装前,须将规格表提交公共卫生局(DPH)审核批准。

The floor finish shall be smooth, durabl.en: The floor finish shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent in all areas where there is food service or preparation, open food storage, warewashing, janitorial service, trash storage, and employee restrooms
The floor finish shall be smooth, durabl.zh: 在食品供应或制备、敞开食品存放、器皿清洗、保洁作业、垃圾存放区域及员工卫生间,地面饰面须光滑、耐用、易于清洁且不吸水。

Toilet rooms shall be separated by well-.en: Toilet rooms shall be separated by well-fitted, self-closing doors that prevent the passage of flies, dust or odors
Toilet rooms shall be separated by well-.zh: 卫生间须以密合良好的自闭门隔开,防止苍蝇、灰尘或异味通过。

Toilet rooms shall be vented to the outs.en: Toilet rooms shall be vented to the outside air by means of an openable, screened window, an air shaft, or a light-switch-activated exhaust fan, consistent with the requirements of local building codes
Toilet rooms shall be vented to the outs.zh: 卫生间须按当地建筑规范要求,通过带纱网的可开启窗户、通风井或与照明开关联动的排风扇向室外通风。

Wall and ceiling finish shall be smooth,.en: Wall and ceiling finish shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent in all areas where there is food service or preparation, open food storage, warewashing, janitorial service, trash storage, and employee restrooms
Wall and ceiling finish shall be smooth,.zh: 在食品供应或制备、敞开食品存放、器皿清洗、保洁作业、垃圾存放区域及员工卫生间,墙面和天花板饰面须光滑、耐用、易于清洁且不吸水。

Adequate handwashing sinks stocked and a.en: Adequate handwashing sinks stocked and accessible.
Adequate handwashing sinks stocked and a.zh: 洗手池数量充足、用品齐备且便于使用。

Chemicals properly identified, stored, a.en: Chemicals properly identified, stored, and used.
Chemicals properly identified, stored, a.zh: 化学品正确标识、存放和使用。

Effective pest control measures. Animals.en: Effective pest control measures. Animals restricted as required.
Effective pest control measures. Animals.zh: 虫害防治措施有效;按要求限制动物进入。

Equipment approved, properly designed, m.en: Equipment approved, properly designed, maintained, and operated.
Equipment approved, properly designed, m.zh: 设备合规、设计得当,并正确维护和操作。

Food contact surfaces of equipment prope.en: Food contact surfaces of equipment properly cleaned and sanitized. Sanitizer solution provided and maintained as required.
Food contact surfaces of equipment prope.zh: 设备的食品接触面已正确清洁和消毒;按要求配备并维持消毒液。

Food protected from potential contaminat.en: Food protected from potential contamination by employees and consumers.
Food protected from potential contaminat.zh: 食品受到保护,防止员工和顾客造成潜在污染。

Food protected from potential cross-cont.zh: 食品受到保护,防止潜在交叉污染。

Grade card posted conspicuously. Consume.en: Grade card posted conspicuously. Consumer advisory as required.
Grade card posted conspicuously. Consume.zh: 评级卡张贴于醒目位置;按要求提供消费者提示。

Handwashing (as required, when required,.en: Handwashing (as required, when required, proper glove use, no bare hand contact of ready to eat foods). Food handler health restrictions as required.
Handwashing (as required, when required,.zh: 洗手(按规定方式与时机洗手,正确使用手套,不徒手接触即食食品);按要求执行食品从业人员健康限制。

Hot and cold running water from approved.en: Hot and cold running water from approved source as required.
Hot and cold running water from approved.zh: 按要求提供来自合规来源的冷热流动水。

No imminently dangerous cross connection.zh: 无紧迫危险的管道交叉连接

Non-TCS food labeled and within shelf-li.en: Non-TCS food labeled and within shelf-life. Food stored off the floor. Proper retail storage of chemicals.
Non-TCS food labeled and within shelf-li.zh: 非温控食品(非TCS)已标识且在保质期内;食品离地存放;零售化学品存放得当。

Nonfood contact surfaces and equipment p.en: Nonfood contact surfaces and equipment properly constructed, installed, maintained, and clean.
Nonfood contact surfaces and equipment p.zh: 非食品接触面及设备构造、安装、维护得当且保持清洁。

Operating within the parameters of the h.en: Operating within the parameters of the health permit. Compliance with Time as a Public Health Control, waiver, specialized process, and Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) plan.
Operating within the parameters of the h.zh: 在健康许可证规定范围内经营;遵守以时间作为公共卫生控制(TPHC)、豁免许可、特殊工艺及危害分析与关键控制点(HACCP)计划的要求。

Person in charge present, demonstrates k.en: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties. Effective employee health policy. Mandated certification and food handler card as required.
Person in charge present, demonstrates k.zh: 现场负责人在岗、具备相应知识并履行职责;员工健康政策有效;按要求持有法定认证及食品从业人员卡。

Personal cleanliness maintained. Persona.en: Personal cleanliness maintained. Personal effects properly stored.
Personal cleanliness maintained. Persona.zh: 保持个人卫生;个人物品妥善存放。

Physical facility in sound condition and.en: Physical facility in sound condition and maintained.
Physical facility in sound condition and.zh: 场所硬件设施状况良好并得到维护。

Proper backflow prevention devices in pl.en: Proper backflow prevention devices in place and maintained.
Proper backflow prevention devices in pl.zh: 已安装并维护适当的防回流装置。

Restrooms, custodial areas, and premises.en: Restrooms, custodial areas, and premises maintained.
Restrooms, custodial areas, and premises.zh: 卫生间、保洁区及场所维护良好。

Sewage or liquid waste not disposed of i.en: Sewage or liquid waste not disposed of in an approved manner
Sewage or liquid waste not disposed of i.zh: 污水或液体废弃物未按合规方式处置。

Signs and certifications as required..zh: 按要求设置标识并持有相关认证。

Small wares approved, properly designed,.en: Small wares approved, properly designed, in good repair.
Small wares approved, properly designed,.zh: 小型器具合规、设计得当且完好无损。

TCS food at proper temperatures..zh: 温控食品(TCS)温度符合要求。

TCS food cooked and reheated to proper t.en: TCS food cooked and reheated to proper temperatures.
TCS food cooked and reheated to proper t.zh: 温控食品(TCS)烹饪及复热达到规定温度。

TCS food labeled and dated as required..en: TCS food labeled and dated as required. Food sold for offsite consumption labeled properly. Records, logs, policies, and procedures maintained and available when required.
TCS food labeled and dated as required..zh: 温控食品(TCS)按要求标识并标注日期;外带食品标识正确;记录、日志、政策及程序妥善保存并可按要求提供。

TCS food thawed and cooled using proper.en: TCS food thawed and cooled using proper methods. Fruits and vegetables washed prior to preparation or service.
TCS food thawed and cooled using proper.zh: 温控食品(TCS)采用正确方法解冻和冷却;水果和蔬菜在制备或供应前已清洗。

Thermometers provided and accurate..zh: 已配备温度计且读数准确。

Utensils, equipment, linens, single-serv.en: Utensils, equipment, linens, single-service/single-use items properly handled, stored, and dispensed.
Utensils, equipment, linens, single-serv.zh: 器具、设备、布草及一次性用品的取用、存放和分发得当。

Ware washing facilities maintained. Wipi.en: Ware washing facilities maintained. Wiping cloths properly stored
Ware washing facilities maintained. Wipi.zh: 器皿清洗设施维护良好;抹布妥善存放。
